## Context posters and opening titles

Blog, release, and widget videos now automatically get context posters and three-second opening titles in portrait and landscape. Each poster pairs real app evidence with a specific title and a short outcome sentence.

The shared scripts use Open Sans, the Shiny palette, and separate layouts for each orientation. Layout checks reject text that overlaps the evidence. Posters become the exported video thumbnails, and opening titles preserve the existing narration and interaction timing.

Both skill variants include updated starters and instructions. Existing projects can use their release, title, and feature description as defaults. New tests cover poster generation, readable layouts, source changes, and opening-title timing.

New productions automatically verify and pin this release. Existing productions keep their current snapshot.
